plan.title: Submit bid on single-stage forward auction

steps.note: Open the existing live forward auction prepared by SRC-SET-007 without creating a different event.
Move to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live auction's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Enter Vendor A's quote of 100 in the pricing sheet.
Submit the vendor's quote; any required terms acceptance available in the portal must be completed as part of the submission flow.
Verify the vendor portal shows the bid as accepted/submitted.
